*.name: Display name for this power (optional; overrides the default).
*.hidden: If true, this power is not listed on the origin screen.
*.condition: Only applies while this condition passes (a DSL condition object — use pick).

neoorigins:action_on_event.entity_action: EntityAction run on the player as a side-effect when the configured event fires.
neoorigins:action_on_event.modifier: FloatModifier (or array) chained onto the event's value (e.g. exhaustion, regen).
neoorigins:action_on_event.block_condition: Block-position filter for block events (block_break, block_place, block_use). Ignored on other events.
neoorigins:action_on_event.effect: EFFECT_APPLIED filter: only fire for this exact mob-effect id (e.g. 'spore:mycelium_ef'). Ignored on other events.
neoorigins:action_on_event.effect_tag: EFFECT_APPLIED filter: only fire for effects in this tag (e.g. '#minecraft:harmful'). Combine with 'effect' (OR-matched). Ignored on other events.
neoorigins:action_on_event.immunity_ticks: EFFECT_APPLIED only: after a successful cleanse (action cancels the event), grant this many ticks of full immunity to the same effect id before re-rolling. 20 = 1s; default 0 (no grace).

neoorigins:active_ability.cooldown_ticks: Cooldown between uses in ticks (20 = 1s); default 60.
neoorigins:active_ability.entity_action: EntityAction tree executed on the player when the keybind fires.
neoorigins:active_ability.hunger_cost: Food/exhaustion points consumed per successful activation; default 0.
neoorigins:active_ability.key: Active keybind slot that triggers the ability.

neoorigins:breath_in_fluid.drain_rate: (legacy) Ticks between each 1-point air drain while submerged; higher = slower (20 = 1s, default).
neoorigins:breath_in_fluid.drain_interval_ticks: Ticks between each 1-point air drain while submerged; clearer alias of drain_rate. Higher = slower drain (20 = 1s).
neoorigins:breath_in_fluid.air_loss_per_second: Air points lost per second while submerged. Higher = faster drain. Overrides drain_interval_ticks / drain_rate when set.
neoorigins:breath_in_fluid.fluid: Fluid that suffocates the player, "water" or "lava"; default water.

neoorigins:condition_passive.entity_action: EntityAction run on the player each interval when the condition passes.
neoorigins:condition_passive.interval_ticks: Ticks between condition checks (20 = 1s); same as interval.

neoorigins:mob_behavior.aggression: neutral = vanilla AI unchanged (only retaliate applies); hostile = always target the target type on sight; conditional = target a player only while every hostile_when condition holds. Default neutral.
neoorigins:mob_behavior.hostile_when: List of conditions (AND-ed) tested against the PROSPECTIVE PLAYER TARGET (piglin-style, e.g. 'player not wearing gold'), not the mob. Only used when aggression = conditional; empty list behaves like hostile.
neoorigins:mob_behavior.retaliate: Also fight back against whatever damaged the mob (vanilla hurt-by-target). Default true.
neoorigins:mob_behavior.anger_linger_ticks: Keep the target this many ticks after the trigger stops holding, so the mob calms down gradually instead of instantly (default 200 = 10s).
neoorigins:mob_behavior.aggro_range: Max distance to acquire a target (default 16.0).
neoorigins:mob_behavior.target_type: Entity type id to be hostile toward; omitted = players. Conditions only apply to player targets.
neoorigins:mob_behavior.call_for_help: When retaliating, alert nearby same-type mobs (vanilla pack aggro). Default false.

neoorigins:conditional.inner_power: Resource id of another power that is only active while this condition holds.

neoorigins:edible_item.always_edible: If true the item can be eaten even at full hunger (default true).
neoorigins:edible_item.fast: If true the item is consumed with the quick eat animation.
neoorigins:edible_item.item_condition: Optional condition an item must match (in addition to items/tags) to be edible.
neoorigins:edible_item.items: List of item ids that become edible (matches items OR tags).
neoorigins:edible_item.meat: If true the food counts as meat for diet/wolf interactions.
neoorigins:edible_item.tags: List of item-tag ids that become edible (matches items OR tags).

neoorigins:effect_immunity.effects: List of mob-effect ids whose application to the player is cancelled.

neoorigins:loot_pool_grant.active: Optional display-only translation key advertising which keybind slot the power expects (e.g. 'key.use_skill_1'). Actual dispatch is via the skill-slot system.
neoorigins:loot_pool_grant.bonus_rolls: Extra rolls added to `rolls` per activation; default 0. Mirrors vanilla loot-pool naming.
neoorigins:loot_pool_grant.cooldown: Cooldown in ticks between activations (20 = 1s); default 0.
neoorigins:loot_pool_grant.grant_id: Unique id tracked so the bundle is granted only once per player. Dedups the whole pool, not individual rolled stacks. Shares the starting_equipment grant attachment so a /origin reset clears both.
neoorigins:loot_pool_grant.loot_table: ResourceLocation of the vanilla loot table to roll on activation (e.g. 'neoorigins:rewards/wood_starter'). Reuses the full vanilla loot infrastructure (weighted entries, conditions, functions, modifiers).
neoorigins:loot_pool_grant.rolls: Number of times the table is rolled per activation; default 1. Combined with bonus_rolls; if both are zero the harness lints the power as a no-op.

neoorigins:modify_damage.direction: "in" scales damage taken, "out" scales damage dealt (default in).
neoorigins:modify_damage.multiplier: Factor applied to the damage; 0.5 halves, 2.0 doubles (default 1.0).
neoorigins:modify_damage.target_group: Optional entity-group filter limiting which targets/attackers apply.

neoorigins:modify_player_spawn.bed_override: If true also overrides the player's bed/anchor spawn, not just respawns.
neoorigins:modify_player_spawn.biome: Biome the resolved respawn location must be in.
neoorigins:modify_player_spawn.dimension: Dimension the player respawns into when spawn is overridden.
neoorigins:modify_player_spawn.spawn_strategy: How the respawn position is chosen within the dimension/biome.

neoorigins:particle.frequency: Emit every N ticks (20 = 1s; default 8, min 1).
neoorigins:particle.offset: [x,y,z] offset in blocks from the player to spawn at (default [0,1,0]).
neoorigins:particle.particle: Particle id, or object form like {type:minecraft:dust,color,scale}.
neoorigins:particle.speed: Particle motion speed passed to the spawn call (default 0.0 = still).

neoorigins:persistent_effect.ambient: If true the effect is ambient (fainter HUD swirl; default true).
neoorigins:persistent_effect.duration: Refresh duration in ticks (20 = 1s); reapplied while active.
neoorigins:persistent_effect.effect: Status effect id to apply for a single-effect entry.
neoorigins:persistent_effect.effects: List of effect entries (effect, amplifier, ambient, show_particles, show_icon).
neoorigins:persistent_effect.show_icon: If true the effect icon shows in the HUD (default true).
neoorigins:persistent_effect.show_particles: If true the effect emits ambient particles (default false).

neoorigins:prevent_action.action: Action blocked: fall_damage, fire, drown, freeze, sprint_food, armor_equip, swim, sleep, elytra...
neoorigins:prevent_action.active_when: When it applies: always, sneaking, not_sneaking, on_ground, not_on_ground.

neoorigins:prevent_death.action: Entity action run on the player each time a lethal hit is prevented.
neoorigins:prevent_death.cooldown_ticks: Ticks the power goes inert after a save (20 = 1s; default 0).
neoorigins:prevent_death.damage_types: Comma-separated damage-type filter; only matching killing blows are prevented.
neoorigins:prevent_death.invert: If true treat damage_types as a blacklist (prevent all except those).
neoorigins:prevent_death.set_health: Health the player is left at after a save (default 1.0, min 1).

neoorigins:resource.color: Hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for the HUD resource bar fill.
neoorigins:resource.label: Display name shown on the HUD resource bar (e.g. "Mana").
neoorigins:resource.max: Maximum value the resource can hold (default 100).
neoorigins:resource.max_action: EntityAction run once when the resource rises to its max.
neoorigins:resource.min: Minimum value the resource can drop to (default 0).
neoorigins:resource.min_action: EntityAction run once when the resource falls to its min.
neoorigins:resource.regen_condition: EntityCondition that must pass for regen to apply (default always).
neoorigins:resource.regen_interval: Ticks between regen ticks (20 = 1s; default 20, min 1).
neoorigins:resource.regen_rate: Amount added each regen interval; 0 disables regen (default 0).
neoorigins:resource.start_value: Value the resource starts at when first granted (default max).

neoorigins:restrict_armor.chest: Item or tag id barred from the chest slot; equipping it ejects the item.
neoorigins:restrict_armor.feet: Item or tag id barred from the feet slot; equipping it ejects the item.
neoorigins:restrict_armor.head: Item or tag id barred from the head slot; equipping it ejects the item.
neoorigins:restrict_armor.legs: Item or tag id barred from the legs slot; equipping it ejects the item.

neoorigins:starting_equipment.components: SNBT data-component patch applied to the granted item.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.count: Stack size of the granted item (default 1).
neoorigins:starting_equipment.enchantments: List of {id, level} enchantments applied to the granted item.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.grant_id: Unique id tracked so the item is granted only once per player.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.item: Item id granted once after the player commits their origin.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.legacy_tag: Apoli-style flat SNBT translated into data components on the item.
neoorigins:starting_equipment.stacks: Plural multi-item shape (v2.1.6): array of {item, count, enchantments, legacy_tag, components} entries granted in order; takes precedence over the singular root fields when non-empty.

neoorigins:tick_action.action_type: Periodic action: teleport_on_damage or none (default none).
neoorigins:tick_action.interval: Ticks between each action run (20 = 1s; default 20).

neoorigins:toggle.default_value: Initial boolean value before the toggle is first flipped (default false).
neoorigins:toggle.key: Identifier other powers read/flip this named boolean by.
